comment: Issue #3501 Track C: ratcheting baseline for the repo self-migration gate (build/run-cs2gs-selfmig.sh). greenFloor is the minimum number of fully-green apps; the *Ceiling metrics cap readability regressions in the migrated output, counted over CODE lines only (string fixtures and comments excluded). Re-baselined 2026-08-27 after the gate-widening arc (#3585/#3586/#3591/#3593/#3596): 33/52 green, labels 0, lifts 29, lines>300 544, bangs 16912. Denominator 52 -> 51 same day: VsGsharp.UnitTests excluded by policy — the Visual Studio extension stays in C# permanently (like the VSCode extension stays in TypeScript), so its unit tests (linked sources from the extension) are not a migration target. It was red at exclusion time, so greenFloor is unchanged. The bangs ceiling RISES with this re-baseline because six formerly-untranslatable apps (LanguageServer, Repl, Compiler/Extensions/Sdk test projects, ...) now emit whole new code trees — the per-app density did not regress, the measured corpus grew. Improve a metric, then tighten the corresponding number in the same PR. Re-baselined 2026-08-30 after the gate-recovery arc: the first COMPLETE run since the corpus was unblocked (33308959087) reports 38/51 green, so greenFloor rises 33 -> 38. Denominator is 51 (Gsharp.Extensions excluded by #3636 — it is an all-.gs bootstrap project, never a migration target). The other four metrics are NOT tightened: labels stayed 0, lifts stayed 29 (ceiling 30), long lines 554 (ceiling 560), and !! rose slightly 16912 -> 17033 (ceiling 17400) because #3650/#3656/#3657/#3665 legitimately insert null-bridges where the translation previously emitted unsound bare reads — a metric that did not improve must not be ratcheted. Remaining red: Core.Tests (94, a newly-revealed layer behind the gsgen wall #3637 cleared), LanguageServer (5, the GS0155 nil/T? family), InternalAnalyzers.Tests (4, analyzer type-identity), Extensions.Tests (2), Interpreter.Tests (translate), and single errors in Repl, Gsharp.NET.Sdk, Compiler.Tests, LanguageServer.Tests, Sdk.Tests, Cs2Gs.Cli, Cs2Gs.Tests, plus GeneratorHost.Tests failing at TEST-PARITY — the first app to reach that stage and fail there. Long-line ceiling raised 560 -> 575 on 2026-08-30: run 33331139589 measured 563. The +9 over the previous 554 is NOT drift — it is legitimate new nullable spellings emitted by the null-bridging arc (#3650/#3656/#3657/#3665/#3690/#3696/#3701), which replace unsound bare reads with correct `T?` declarations and `!!` bridges; a correct `?`/`!!` costs characters. Verified independent of the concurrent #3704 cascade: unlike the `!!` count (which that cascade inflated, because an app that fails to compile never runs stage 2's polish pass), this app's long-line count was 85 both before AND after its polish pass, so the compile failure does not explain the delta. Headroom chosen so the in-flight nullability work (#3694/#3700/#3706/#3709) does not re-breach on landing; tighten again once that arc settles. The other metrics are unchanged and greenFloor stays 38 pending a clean run.
